description: Malawi RESTORE road reconstruction and climate risk assessment after Cyclone Freddy provides a documented use of road-vulnerability assessment and GIS evidence to prioritise climate-resilient reconstruction. The provider is OECD. Geographical and temporal coverage: The RESTORE case concerns Malawi after Cyclone Freddy in 2023, especially M1 and S152 corridors. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: OECD explicitly states reconstruction was at preparation or early implementation and results were unavailable. This record covers the completed assessment use, not realised reconstruction benefits. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
